## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck + `node --check server.js` + build)
- [ ] No secrets, `.env`, `runtime/`, or heavy binaries committed
- [ ] Matches surrounding code style (CommonJS in `server/**`, TS/React in `src/**`)
- [ ] New data sources (if any) use **public** APIs only
- [ ] I described what and why above
